title: domain/auth.py — JWT + bcrypt pure domain functions
scope: Four pure functions. No SQLAlchemy, no HTTP, no I/O. (1) get_password_hash(plain) → str: CryptContext(schemes=['bcrypt']).hash(plain). (2) verify_password(plain, hashed) → bool: pwd_context.verify(plain, hashed) — constant-time. (3) create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: timedelta | None = None) → str: merges data with {'exp': now+delta}, jose.jwt.encode(to_encode, SECRET_KEY, algorithm='HS256'); default delta = timedelta(hours=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_HOURS from config, fallback 8h). (4) decode_access_token(token: str) → dict | None: jose.jwt.decode(token, SECRET_KEY, algorithms=['HS256']); catches JWTError + ExpiredSignatureError → returns None (never raises).
